title: 第5732章 疗伤第5731章 树后隐藏
lines: 林昆狼吞虎咽吃完，打了个饱嗝，肚子填饱了，身体随之恢复力气。
他这才低头查看身上伤势，伤的不重，但是也不轻，当然这个不重，是相对于他曾经在战场上而言，只要不是致命伤，就都不算严重，可这伤如果放在普通人身上，那就是要命的存在。
其他身上的伤口还好，就是大一些深一些，现在几乎已经不流血了，这要归功于他的身体素质，止血能力比较强。
但接下来还要面临一个危险，这些伤口在炎热的环境下很容易发炎，一旦发炎之后就要面对发热，在这种荒郊野外发热很容易产生休克，要是再感染其他细菌，就会出现败血病等症状。
最好的处理方式应该是杀菌消毒，然后缝合，可这小岛上哪有这条件。
抛开这皮肉伤不说，最重的是他胸前肋骨三根骨折，骨折的程度应该不严重，但同样在这种野外情况下非常危险。
肋骨发生骨折，其内部就会有相应炎症，吃点抗生素药物可以缓解，可这里哪有？
还有一处严重的伤是左臂，在与大鲨鱼搏斗的时候被撞击成严重骨折，之前身体疲乏一心求生，忽略了疼痛，现在这股子疼痛变本加厉找回来。
骨折如果不及时处理，碎裂的骨头还容易将周围的肉戳破，引起内在的伤势。
简单来说，就算现在没有医疗条件，但他也急需医治，否则这不算太严重的伤，也会要了他的命。
林昆是绝对不会坐以待毙的，他向篝火里添了两把干柴，避免篝火熄灭，岛上不一定藏着什么样的野兽，只要这篝火还亮着，就能多一份保全自己的机会。
从篝火里拿出一根燃烧的火棍，林昆开始向不远处的小树林摸去，打算找一些东西来处理身上的伤口。
夜晚的树林格外诡异，安静的令人感觉心神不安，正常来说这种轮子里是应该有动静的，现在如此安静，一定是有某种可怕的动物，将所有生物震慑。
林昆现在不去细想这么多，找不到能处理身上伤口的东西，用不到天亮他就会发烧。
一旦发起烧来，严重的话精神就会变得恍惚，万一这个时候被野兽偷袭，几乎是十死无生。
在小树林边缘转了一圈，林昆没有深入，并不是他怕了，而是今天白天折腾了一大顿，他真没有精力再和这林子里陌生的野兽战斗，当务之急是处理伤口。
大概20分钟后，林昆找到了需要的东西，回到岸边的篝火堆旁，此时的篝火已经燃烧殆尽，好在还有一点火苗。
添了两把才进去，火焰慢慢变大起来。
此刻这一摊篝火，是方圆一大片黑暗中唯一的亮点。
林昆将找来的树针取出来，然后脱掉上衣，从衣服中抽出线，再将线头系在树针尾端。
林昆长呼出一口气，借着火光对着肚子上的伤口先缝合起来，树针可以当针用，但比正常的应用真要出太多，哪怕经过处理，也还是跟普通的钉子差不多粗。
这种粗下又粗糙的树针，扎在皮肉上的疼痛可想而知，林昆一声不发，但额头上已经渗出一层细汗，汗水凝结滴落，恰好落在伤口上，激起一阵刺痛。
林昆一口气将身上的伤口都缝合完，然后又取来准备好的树脂给胸前以及左胳膊进行固定，没有绳子就用衣服撕成的布条当绳子，等做好这一切已经是两个小时后。
他扑通一声躺在沙滩上，大口喘的粗气，现在没有消毒条件，也没有抗生素可吃，只能默默祈祷今天夜里不要发烧。
content_en:
Lin Kun devoured the food and burped. His stomach was full and his body regained its strength.
He then lowered his head to check the injuries on his body. The injuries were not serious, but they were not light either. Of course, this was not serious, compared to what he had experienced on the battlefield. As long as it was not a fatal injury, it was not serious. But if this injury were placed on an ordinary person, it would be fatal.
The other wounds on his body were okay, but they were larger and deeper, and they were almost no longer bleeding. This was due to his physical fitness and his relatively strong ability to stop bleeding.
But then there is another danger. These wounds are easily inflamed in hot environments. Once inflamed, they will have to face fever. Fever in this wilderness can easily cause shock. If they are infected with other bacteria, symptoms such as septicemia will appear.
The best way to deal with it should be to sterilize and then sew it up, but there is no such condition on this small island.
Aside from the flesh injuries, the most serious thing was that three ribs on his chest were fractured. The fractures should not be serious, but they are also very dangerous in such wild conditions.
When a rib is fractured, there will be corresponding inflammation inside it. Taking some antibiotics can alleviate it, but where can it be found here?
There was another serious injury to his left arm, which was severely fractured when he was fighting a big shark. Before, his body was exhausted and focused on survival, ignoring the pain. Now the pain is getting worse.
If a fracture is not treated promptly, the broken bones can easily pierce the surrounding flesh, causing internal injuries.
To put it simply, even if he does not have medical conditions now, he still needs medical treatment urgently, otherwise this injury, which is not too serious, will kill him.
Lin Kun would never sit still and wait for death. He added two handfuls of dry wood to the bonfire to prevent the bonfire from extinguishing. There may not be any kind of wild beasts hiding on the island. As long as the bonfire is still lit, he will have one more chance to save himself.
Taking out a burning fire stick from the bonfire, Lin Kun began to touch the woods not far away, intending to find something to treat the wounds on his body.
The woods at night are particularly eerie and so quiet that it makes people feel uneasy. Normally there should be movement in this kind of wheel. But now that it is so quiet, there must be some kind of terrifying animal that scares all living things.
If Lin Kun doesn't think about it too much now, he can't find anything that can treat the wounds on his body. He will have a fever before dawn.
Once a fever breaks out, the spirit will become trance-like if it is serious. If a wild beast attacks you at this time, it is almost impossible to survive.
After walking around the edge of the woods, Lin Kun didn't go deep. It wasn't because he was afraid, but because he had gone through a lot of trouble during the day. He really didn't have the energy to fight the strange beasts in the woods anymore. The first priority was to treat his wounds.
About 20 minutes later, Lin Kun found what he needed and returned to the bonfire on the shore. At this time, the bonfire had burned out, but fortunately there was still a little flame.
After adding two handfuls, the flame slowly grew bigger.
At this moment, this bonfire was the only bright spot in a large area of ​​darkness.
Lin Kun took out the tree needles he found, then took off his shirt, pulled out the thread from the clothes, and tied the thread ends to the ends of the tree needles.
"Huh..."
Lin Kun took a long breath and used the firelight to sew up the wound on his stomach first. The tree needles could be used as needles, but they produced too many needles compared to normal use. Even after treatment, they were still about the same thickness as ordinary nails.
One can imagine the pain caused by such thick and rough tree needles piercing the skin. Lin Kun said nothing, but a layer of fine sweat had already seeped out on his forehead. The sweat condensed and dripped, and it happened to fall on the wound, causing a stinging pain.
Lin Kun sewed up all the wounds on his body in one breath, and then took the prepared resin to fix his chest and left arm. If there was no rope, he used strips of cloth torn from clothes as ropes. It was already two hours after he finished all this.
He plopped down on the beach, breathing heavily. There was no sterilization or antibiotics available, so he could only pray silently that he would not have a fever tonight.
title_en: Chapter 5732 Healing Chapter 5731 Hiding behind the tree
